getCatalogVariables.dynamic_outputs: docs/api/flow/action-api.md:679 and docs/guides/wfa-flow-actions-guide.md:1055 say "no outputs"; the typings return OutputsWithDotwalk<Record<string, FlowValueType>> (sdk-core/dist/external/flow/built-ins/actions/core/getCatalogVariables.now.d.ts) and the sample reads answers as pills (src/fluent/flow-trigger-catalog-item.now.ts:158) — trust those

wait_duration.note: With a schedule, each day of the duration is 24 hours of schedule time (docs/api/flow/wfa-flow-logic-api.md:493, "business-hours calculation"), so {"days": 2} on an 8-hour weekday schedule is about 6 working days. For "N working days" the schedule placeholder must be a Monday–Friday all-day (24h) schedule with holidays; otherwise give the offset in schedule hours (16 hours = 2 days of an 8h schedule).

unsupported.go_back_to: Workflow Studio "Go back to" is not in Fluent (SDK 4.13.3 wfa.flowLogic has no goBackTo: sdk-core/dist/external/flow/flow-logic/index.d.ts). Put the steps to repeat in a do_until block with the exit condition.
unsupported.make_a_decision: Decision tables are not in Fluent (SDK 4.13.3). Use an if step with else_if branches, one per answer.
unsupported.decision: Decision tables are not in Fluent (SDK 4.13.3). Use an if step with else_if branches, one per answer.
unsupported.call_workflow: Call a Workflow is not in Fluent (SDK 4.13.3). Leave it out and tell the user to add it in Workflow Studio.
unsupported.dynamic_flow: Dynamic Flow is not in Fluent (SDK 4.13.3). Leave it out and tell the user.
unsupported.get_flow_outputs: Get Flow Outputs is not in Fluent (SDK 4.13.3). Leave it out and tell the user.
unsupported.subflow: This skill uses core actions only (subflows are out of scope). Inline the steps.
unsupported.script: The skill never writes code. Use core actions and flow logic; for a computed date use wait_duration with a schedule placeholder.
unsupported.inline_script: The skill never writes code. Use core actions and flow logic; for a computed date use wait_duration with a schedule placeholder.
unsupported.set_flow_variables: Flow variables are not in this skill's vocabulary. Read the value again with a pill where it is needed.
unsupported.exit_loop: Not in this skill's vocabulary. Put the rest of the loop body inside an if step.
unsupported.skip_iteration: Not in this skill's vocabulary. Put the loop body inside an if step.
unsupported.wait_for_condition: Waiting for a record condition is the action waitForCondition (not flow logic): {"action":"waitForCondition", …}.
unsupported.record_deleted: There is no record-deleted trigger in Fluent (trigger-api.md lists created, updated, createdOrUpdated).
unsupported.rest_api: The REST API trigger is not a Fluent trigger (trigger-api.md). Use a record or scheduled trigger.
unsupported.metricbase: The MetricBase trigger is not a Fluent trigger (trigger-api.md).
unsupported.kafka_message: The Kafka Message trigger is not a Fluent trigger (trigger-api.md).
